title: Home screen
shows: Morning readiness score from a 15 second check-in (sleep plus three quick questions), today's training session, and calories and macros remaining for the day.

title: Food log
shows: Today's meals logged with calories and protein, carbs and fat for each one, with a quick Add a meal button. Meals can be logged from a photo.

title: Coach chat
shows: A chat with an AI coach that knows your calorie and protein targets and what you have eaten today, and answers things like how to hit your protein.

title: Training plan
shows: A weekly training plan built around your goal, equipment and schedule, with sessions you tick off and a way to ask for changes like more arm work or shorter sessions.

title: Progress
shows: A weight trend line, weekly averages for calories and protein, and daily water and sleep tracking.

title: Workout log
shows: Logging a session set by set with kg, reps and reps in reserve, with the exercise, tempo and rest time shown for each lift.
